title.narrative: IAEA Marie Sklodowska Curie Fellowship Programme

description.narrative: The MSCFP is a flagship initiative of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) designed to support women pursuing Master’s degrees in nuclear-related fields, including medicine, climate science and other nuclear application fields. The overall objective of the programme is to strengthen the representation and participation of women in nuclear and nuclear-related fields while contributing to sustainable socioeconomic development through education, training and capacity building. The programme is supported through voluntary contributions from IAEA Member States and partners, including from the private sector and foundations. The support received from Norad will be used in support of women from ODA-eligible countries.
